name: Legacy Technology Holdings, Inc.
summary: Legacy Technology Holdings, Inc., founded in 2012 and headquartered in Arvada, Colorado, specializes in creating and bringing to market an internet-based software solution. This platform is designed for both preventative genomic medicine and broader medical applications. It employs sophisticated algorithms to conduct thorough analyses of diverse individual patient data, encompassing lifestyle elements such as blood test results, biometric information, dietary habits, and environmental factors, in addition to nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and genetic indicators.
